Off-pool h4: 8-thread custom rayon pool via OnceLock+install. CRASHED on second proof: lean-rayon-0 worker hit "failed to lock mutex: Invalid argument" + "rayon vec mid > len". Diagnosis: zkalloc per-phase reset between proofs invalidates worker thread state when workers spawn AFTER the first begin_phase. Default rayon pool spawns workers during precompute_dft_twiddles (BEFORE begin_phase), so they register with zkalloc cleanly. Custom-pool workers spawn lazily on first install() = inside begin_phase = zkalloc state mismatch. Classify (b) implementation-bug; attempt 2 = init pool earlier.

Hooked rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder::build_global(8) into precompute_dft_twiddles, so workers spawn before any zkalloc activity. Smoke test passes. Eval: REGRESSION +10.94% (p=1.2e-5). The lost P-units (16% headroom drop) far exceeds the cvwait reduction. Profile-anchored mechanism didn't translate: even with 8 threads (≈4P+4E), some E-cores remain laggers AND the now-missing 2 E-cores' compute is no longer absorbed. Classify (a) hypothesis-wrong. h4 exhausted. Counter: 4.

Target A.3 mds_fft constant fold (push lambda16 muls INTO IFFT's last bt layer). Phase-1 kill: critical-path math shows ZERO saving on M4 NEON. Without fusion: 8 parallel bt's (2 cycles SIMD) then 16 parallel lambda muls (3 cycles) = 5-cycle stage. With fusion: bt+lambda = 2 adds → 2 muls, sequential per element, 2+3 = 5 cycles. Identical depth, identical mul count. Pool itself rated A.3 at +1-2% (below gate floor) — analysis confirms even the upper end isn't reachable via this mechanism on NEON. No implementation needed; kill condition fires before measurement per Phase 1 protocol. Counter: 5.

Target A.2 single-permutation re-scheduling for ZMM register budget. Phase-1 kill: target mechanism is the 2.22% AVX-512 stack-spill hot line (vmovdqa64 to/from %rsp). NEON does NOT have this — 4 PackedKB per state × 1 perm = 4 of 32 NEON Q-regs, 87% headroom. Even the partial-round body's max live set fits comfortably. Secondary mechanism (LLVM scheduler dep-chain shortening from explicit lifetime boundaries) is bounded by the 15-cycle critical path (sbox 6 + rc 3 + final mul/add 6) which my "+rc fusion" subanalysis showed is unshortenable: moving +rc from mid-chain to the +partial_dot step preserves total depth. Confirmed Phase 1 kill before implementation. Counter: 6.

Novel surface: rayon 12-thread oversubscription. Hypothesis: more workers than logical CPUs (10) → continuous availability when one stalls → less cvwait. Phase-1 kill: M4 has no SMT, so 12 threads on 10 cores requires OS context-switching. iter 4 already demonstrated that even GOING DOWN to 8 threads (giving up 2 E-cores' work) regresses wall by 10.94% — the 4P+6E heterogeneity tax dominates over scheduler-level gains. Going UP would add context-switch overhead on top of unchanged cvwait. Same predicted direction (regression). Not implementing per Phase 1 protocol. Counter: 9.
